name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover a ceiling leak from rain?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover a ceiling leak from rain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowner's insurance policies typically cover sudden and accidental water damage, including ceiling leaks caused by rain, provided the damage isn't due to neglect or a lack of maintenance. For instance, damage from a sudden storm would likely be covered, but a leak caused by an old, unmaintained roof might not. It's crucial to review your specific policy and contact your insurance provider promptly after discovering a leak to understand your coverage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance often covers sudden ceiling leaks from rain, but not those caused by neglect. Check your policy and contact your provider quickly.
